dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped annuli on the posterior-lateral surface; perimeters consist of high-intensity light pixels transitioning sharply to dark-toned centers; edges are non-uniform in thickness with ragged boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid light-toned pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily situated in the interstitial spaces between the larger annuli on the rear dorsal quadrant.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent posterior annuli form an obtuse triangle, with the longest side extending toward the anterior portion of the seal's torso.
